notes.note: Scoped #3002 loading-state review: HomeRolePane now routes unavailable and standard-data selections through one default fallback, preserving the existing quiet built-in Home while plugin inventory is loading. A data alternative must not produce an uninstalled/failed claim before inventory settles. The existing component test is table-driven over descriptors with and without that alternative; the added case failed before the fix and passed after. No consent, grant, persistence, navigation, rendering-tier or unrelated document contract changed.
